$comment: Language-neutral golden vectors binding the TS capture-core and the Hermes Python sanitize port (ADR 0002). Both test suites consume this file. All secret-shaped values are fabricated fixtures for redaction tests.

redact_secret_assignment_full.$comment: Full keyword set (API_KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|PRIVATE_KEY). Capture-path policy (Claude runtime).

redact_secret_assignment_basic.$comment: Basic keyword set (no PRIVATE_KEY). Recall-query policy (OpenClaw/Hermes runtimes).

strip_context_blocks.$comment: Injected membase context/handoff blocks, untrusted metadata blocks, and <final> tags are removed; surrounding text survives.

casual_chat.$comment: Uses the shared CASUAL_PATTERNS with the OpenClaw/Hermes keyword list; input is lower-cased by the implementation.

recall_query_clamp.$comment: Code blocks dropped, whitespace collapsed, clamped to 240 chars.

neutralize_injection.$comment: Render-time defense: untrusted memory text interpolated into harness-injected blocks must not close a block early or forge a control tag. Every <membase-*> tag plus <system-reminder> is neutralized with a zero-width space (U+200B) after '<'; the text stays readable, the tag inert. Case-preserving, case-insensitive match; attributes after the tag name still match via the word boundary. Idempotent: a neutralized tag no longer matches.

cases.in: <membase-contextual> unknown membase tags are neutralized too
cases.out: <​membase-contextual> unknown membase tags are neutralized too

cases.in: <membase> bare tag without a dash is not membase-*
cases.out: <membase> bare tag without a dash is not membase-*
